title: Generic point of an irreducible closed subset
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $Z\subseteq X$ an irreducible closed subset [def-weil-irreducible-components]. A *generic point* of $Z$ is a point $\xi\in Z$ such that $Z=\overline{\{\xi\}}$, the closure of the one-point set $\{\xi\}$ in $X$. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] this is applied to its underlying topological space; the generic point of an irreducible component of $X$ (an irreducible closed subset) is a generic point of that component in this sense.
